name: Kalletal (Germany)
description: Horizontal tricolour of blue, white and blue in the proportions 1:3:1, charged towards the hoist with the municipal arms of Kalletal (a red saltire and a fish on blue and yellow).
history: By deed of the Regierungspräsident in Detmold of 21 June 1972 the municipality of Kalletal was granted the right to bear arms, a flag, a banner and an official seal; the flag is blue-white-blue 1:3:1 with the arms shifted slightly forward, the banner with the arms above the centre.
